title: Discounted Fees at Savings-Network Practices
content:
# Discounted Fees at Savings-Network Practices

**Pricing basis.** At a practice holding an active Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement, a member of one of the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships pays the usual fee for the practice's ZIP region less the discount percentage for the service category, rounded half up to the cent; Cascade pays nothing. Outside the savings network there is no discount, and a member who reports within the visit-price dispute period of 90 calendar days that a practice did not honor the discount is referred to provider relations.

## The discount percentage

The percentage is the one the member's membership sets for the service category: preventive, basic restorative, major, orthodontic, specialist, implant or cosmetic and, when vision is included in the membership, eye exam, eyewear (frames and lenses) or contact lenses. For each of the six memberships — Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household — the preventive, major and eyewear percentages, like every other category, are that membership's own percentages in its schedule of discounts.

## The amounts of a discounted visit

- **Usual fee:** the practice's usual fee for the service, for its ZIP region.
- **Fee paid by the member:** the usual fee less the discount percentage of it, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Savings:** the usual fee less the fee paid by the member.
- **Paid by Cascade:** nothing.

Each discounted service at a savings-network practice is recorded as a visit, with the practice's savings-network agreement, the service category, the usual fee, the fee paid by the member, the savings and the visit date.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A member whose membership sets 30 percent for basic restorative services has a filling at a savings-network practice whose usual fee for its ZIP region is a hypothetical 96.25. Thirty percent of 96.25 is 28.875; 96.25 less 28.875 is 67.375, which rounds half up to 67.38. The member pays 67.38, the savings are 96.25 less 67.38, that is 28.87, and Cascade pays nothing.

## Points of judgement

- A practice without an active Cascade Savings Network Participating Provider Agreement: no discount.
- A vision category under a membership that does not include vision: no vision percentage applies.
- A member reporting, on the twentieth day after a visit, that the practice charged the full usual fee: within the 90 calendar days, so the member is referred to provider relations.
